about: Your Steam library in the dashboard: profile and level, play time, achievements with their rarity, the games you played last and a calendar of the days you played. It also counts the games you launch from outside Steam.
highlights: The game you played last is featured, with its achievements and how rare each one is
A month calendar shaded by how much you played each day
Games added to Steam as shortcuts and their sessions are included
Games you hid or marked as private in Steam stay out
author: iMacnucintosh

changes: No more console warning when the achievements list closes
The featured game is the one played last
A status block shows whether Steam, Millennium and its plugin are found
The activity calendar is shaded relative to your busiest day
Games marked as private in your Steam library are no longer shown
First release in the hub (it used to ship with the shell)
